central_law: НЕ ПУТАЙ ОДИНАКОВЫЕ ЗАПИСИ С ОДИНАКОВЫМИ МАШИНАМИ.
ИЩИ ОДИНАКОВУЮ РАБОТУ МИРА ПОД РАЗНЫМИ ПРЕДСТАВЛЕНИЯМИ.
problem_statement: R3/R3.1 found a stable cross-domain ordered regularity, but R3.2 showed that the strict survivor was mainly the registry's own epistemic recording protocol rather than a shared subject-level scientific mechanism. R4 must therefore treat the JANUS recording machine as an explicit negative control and search only after decontaminating it.

frozen_negative_control.name: JANUS CROSS-DOMAIN RECORD COMMIT MACHINE
frozen_negative_control.rule: Any candidate explainable primarily by this record/document protocol is not eligible for domain-mechanism promotion.
frozen_negative_control.failure_meaning: If R4 rediscovers this control as a top subject-level machine, decontamination has failed.

target_object.name: SUBJECT_LEVEL_TRANSFORMATION_MACHINE
target_object.requirement: Every operator must map to the actual subject of the source artifact, not to JSON layout, provenance bookkeeping, workflow state, commit mechanics, receipt structure, file identity or governance syntax.

decontamination_layers.interpretation: These signals may be necessary metadata but cannot by themselves instantiate a subject-level machine.
Governance state is not domain state unless the source subject itself is a governance system.
A candidate must survive reordering or serialization controls showing it is not an artifact of JSON/text field order.
Retain only operators that can be expressed as subject input, transformation, output, response or falsifier.

formal_gate.admission: ADMIT(M) only if S(M) > max(R(M), G(M)) AND H(M) passes AND negative controls fail to explain M.
formal_gate.compact: SUBJECT_SIGNAL > RECORD_SIGNAL AND SUBJECT_SIGNAL > GOVERNANCE_SIGNAL AND HELDOUT_MATCH => CANDIDATE_ONLY
formal_gate.claim_ceiling: Even admitted R4 outputs remain CANDIDATE_ONLY until independent semantic/mechanistic verification.

target_diagnostic.purpose: Diagnostic only; the same miner and score apply to all domains.

next_gate: Implement R4 executable decontamination miner and CI. Run against a fresh derivative-clean registry snapshot. Preserve all negative-control hits, excluded candidates, held-out failures and surviving subject-level machines in generated JSON receipts before any interpretation.
seal: REMOVE THE RECORDING MACHINE FROM THE SKY. THEN ASK WHETHER THE WORLD STILL MOVES THE SAME WAY.
